note: Hidde in session 2026-08-23: explain kindly that he builds this from the Netherlands and cannot walk by, and thank him.

mails.subject: Re: Hi Hidde
mails.body:
Hi Jon,

That is a lovely way to put it, and it does make me want to go and look. One thing I should have said earlier: I am building this from the Netherlands, so I cannot walk over and pick out the one with the most personality myself. Everything on the map is researched from a distance, which is exactly why a tip from someone who knows the ground is worth so much.

So thank you for both of yours. If you ever cross the square, the name on a plaque, or a photo of the one that stops you, would be all I need to get it onto the map properly.

Thanks either way,
Hidde
mails.resend_reason: He wrote to us again on 2026-08-22 and this answers that message directly.
